body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> ATEC presented ‘AV470A’, 42-inch Full HD TV and is the First provider among small and medium enterprises. It is equipped with Super-IPS panel from LG-Philips and supports clear screen which is 4 times better than SD TV. When connected by PC, it provides 1920*1080 resolution and users can download 1080p Full HD output through component and HDMI terminal. Its high-tech interior image combined with electronic touchpad in the menu buttons. Furthermore,users can make additional adjustment to the volume control with vivid surround sound accordingly.
